events.title: Fractional factorial over feature families launched
events.detail: Frozen 2^(5-1) resolution V design (16 runs, generator E=ABCD, all main effects and two-factor interactions orthogonal) over families A-E, draws 14-15 x four folds, response = masked holdout DTI of the standard emission. Preregistration: knowledge/12_preregistered_factorial_families_2026-10-03.md.

events.title: Fractional factorial completed and reported
events.detail: 128 fits (16 runs x draws 14-15 x 4 folds, 1276.5 s). Supported inclusion effects under the frozen rule: B (DEM curvature/scarp, +0.0241, 8/8 cells positive) and E (visible-catalogue geometry, +0.0596, 8/8); supported interactions AC, AD, CD positive and AB, BD negative. C (strain/seismicity) is negative but its worst cells breach the -0.010 stability floor, so the frozen rule refuses to certify it. Report: knowledge/14_factorial_results_2026-10-03.md; raw: evidence/factorial_families/.

events.title: H31 worming-persistence screen failed; cause diagnosed
events.detail: 40 validated cells, drawings 10/11, 921 s. The four T_* arms produced identical emitted sets in 8/8 cells because the five persistence features are nonzero on 0.001%-0.084% of the footprint (max 4,350 px of 5,167,373). Only the H27 tip control moved (+0.0083). Report: knowledge/16_h31_screen_results_2026-10-03.md.

events.title: Repository candidate built and added as the best-evidenced file
events.detail: HGB habitat trained on every catalogue pixel (3-seed average), frozen standard emission (ridge NMS -> drop known -> top 2.45% -> score-ordered Poisson dots at 2.4 px): 37,913 dots, zero catalogue pixels, float32 single band, NaN outside the footprint, format receipt ok_to_upload=True, content id a4d439b07426. Its method scores 0.1409 on the catalogue-hidden proxy versus 0.0983 for the historical D2.8 on identical draws, while the SGMC proxy prefers the historical file (0.0953 vs 0.0847); the conflict is registered and the file is not slot-approved. Documentation: knowledge/17.
